title: Classic POINTCLOUD omitted DWG field refusal
scope: Prevent silent loss of locally modeled fields in classic POINTCLOUD DWG encoding.

evidence.observation: The source-list branch omits extent/UCS and extended fields; the zero-source branch places extended fields under SINCE(R_2013b); clipping vertices are 2RD and depth applies to type 1.
Establishes libdxfrw model defaults for omitted fields.

implementation: Reject nondefault extent/UCS, count, handles, intensity and clipping fields omitted for source-file lists.
Reject nondefault handles, intensity and clipping fields omitted from AC1021/AC1024 zero-source layout.
Reject nonzero clipping-vertex Z and nonzero type-2/3 depth; preserve type-1 depth.

validation.result: 3/3 passed; 106 individually mutated omission/refusal/retry cases plus two type-1 depth output controls

limitations: LibreDWG's R2013b boundary is finer than libdxfrw's AC1027 enum; this change does not qualify all AC1027 producer variants.
The peer grammar and generated controls do not establish native rendering or broader support.
No DWG or DXF fixture was added.
